description: Extract Reviews / Pros & Cons / Q&A text from a theresanaiforthat.com product detail page using native DOM reads. TAAFT detail pages keep all three sections in stable containers (#rw_cont / #pros-and-cons / #faq) present in the DOM without tab clicks, so three DOM.getText reads replace the v1 Runtime.evaluate heading-heuristic script (live-proven across 11 products, task 5d69c57d p2-p5, 2026-07-04). Persistence (record_extraction) is a harness post-step.

steps.purpose: Open the TAAFT product detail page in the SAME reused tab (avoids fresh-tab Cloudflare; re-navigating a warm tab keeps clearance). onError:continue — a heavy real page makes the navigate CALL return -32001 timeout while the page actually loads; the next listen Page.loaded settles it.

params.expression: function chl(){var t=(document.title||'').toLowerCase();var m=['just a moment','verify you are human','checking your browser','attention required'];var hit=m.some(function(s){return t.indexOf(s)>=0;});return {challenge:hit?'yes':''};}return chl();

steps.purpose: Detect a Cloudflare/CAPTCHA challenge by TITLE markers only (challengeFlag='yes' only when challenged). URL markers are deliberately absent: after auto-clearance the URL can retain a residual __cf_chl_rt_tk param while the page is already the real product page (live-observed 2026-07-04), so a URL check would false-positive into a 20-minute Hitl.resumed wait. Deliberately kept as Runtime.evaluate: this is the challenge BOUNDARY (control flow), not content extraction, and make_challenge_poller mirrors this exact JS on the second connection.
Dismiss the auth/signup overlay if present (harmless when absent; live-used by p2/p4 workers before section reads)

Bind the extraction to THIS row's page: the harness compares pageUrl against the navigated detailUrl and rejects the row on mismatch. Without this, a soft-failed navigate (onError:continue) in a same-tab batch would silently read the PREVIOUS row's sections. Native Page.getState — no JS.

Read the Reviews container #rw_cont via native DOM.getText (works off-viewport; returns full comment bodies — fixes the v1 reviews-body TODO). onError:continue — the section is genuinely absent on some products (-32005; e.g. rank 37 in task 5d69c57d) and absence must not kill the run.
Read the Pros & Cons container #pros-and-cons via native DOM.getText. onError:continue — section may be genuinely absent; the variables_any_nonempty contract gates overall success.
Read the Q&A container #faq via native DOM.getText. onError:continue — section may be genuinely absent; the variables_any_nonempty contract gates overall success.
